effects: Equip: Your harmful spells and abilities have a chance to bleed your target for 846 Physical damage every 1.8 over 10 sec.
Equip: Your harmful spells and abilities have a chance to increase your Avoidance by 80 for 10 sec.

Equip: The light protects. There is a chance when you are attacked to gain Palisade's Protection, granting an absorption shield for 1,192 damage lasting 6 sec. Should the shield be breached before it expires, the magic of the shield will erupt with Palisade's Penance, dealing 1,192 Holy damage to nearby enemies.

Equip: Your damaging spells and abilities have a chance to afflict your target with a Necrotic Hex, inflicting 1,612 Nature damage over 10 sec. This hex spreads to enemies near your original victim every time it deals damage, up to 5 times.

Equip: Your spells and abilities have a chance to resonate with the Worldsoul, creating an Orb of Azerothian Power nearby. Gathering this orb empowers you, granting 25 of your highest secondary stat for 15 sec.
Equip: Dealing damage to a target has a chance to mark them, causing an Elven Ranger to launch a Surprise Attack from afar! This surprise attack deals 6,530 Physical damage to the target.
Equip: Your spells and abilities have a chance to fill you with Battle Fervor. Battle Fervor increases your Haste by 2 for 15 sec, stacking up to 5 times.
Equip: Your spells and abilities have a chance to deal 3,707 Radiant damage to your current target.
Equip: Your healing and damaging spells have a chance to increase your Mastery by 30 for 12 sec.

Equip: Your damaging spells and abilities have a chance to charge the band, calling forth the avatar of a Loa to assist you in combat. Each unique socketed gem color in your gear allows for different Loa to be summoned. These effects range from dealing damage to your foes or granting you temporary power.

Equip: Your spells and abilities may cause the signet to resonate with the Worldsoul, granting you a boon of 4 to all of your secondary stats for 15 sec. Every unique socketed gem color strengthens their associated secondary stat granted by this boon by 1%.

Equip: Your spells and abilities have a chance to call upon the Phoenix Flames to envelop your target. If your target is friendly, they are healed for 7,742 over 10 sec. If your target is an enemy, they instead suffer 7,821 Fire damage over 10 sec. Every unique socketed gem color will strengthen the flames by 1%.
On Use: Activate the array and generate a Voidstone Barrier, absorbing 71,596 damage for the next 10 sec. The barrier is further empowered by 1% per unique gem color you have socketed.

Equip: Your damaging spells and abilities have the chance to grant Farstrider's Guile, increasing your lowest secondary stat by 444 for 15 sec. When an allied player dies, gain 232 of your highest secondary stat for 15 sec. This effect can only occur once every 5 min. This effect is augmented by Darkmoon Sigil: Blood.

Equip: Afflict your target with Rotting Roots dealing 214 Nature Damage every 2 seconds for 6 sec. This effect stacks up to 10 times. New stacks do not refresh applied stacks. This effect is augmented by Darkmoon Sigil: Rot.
Equip: Your spells and abilities have the chance to grant 168 secondary stats for 15 sec based on the target creature's type. This effect is augmented by Darkmoon Sigil: Hunt.

Equip: Your damaging spells and abilities have the chance to embolden you in Void Glass granting 123 Versatility over 15 sec. Multiple applications can overlap. This effect is augmented by Darkmoon Sigil: Void.
Equip: When you heal or deal damage you have a chance to increase your Strength, Agility, or Intellect by 162 for 15 sec. Your highest stat is always chosen.
Equip: Increases the effect that healing and mana potions have on the wearer by 40%. This effect does not stack.
